fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects using WorkFolders.exe to execute an arbitrary control.exe
fields.name: Execution via WorkFolders.exe
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\control.exe" and src.process.image.path contains "\\WorkFolders.exe") and (not tgt.process.image.path="C:\\Windows\\System32\\control.exe")))
